arxiv-2112-12566.title: Integrating Material Selection with Design Optimization via Neural Networks
arxiv-2112-12566.creator: Aaditya Chandrasekhar, Saketh Sridhara, Krishnan Suresh
arxiv-2112-12566.description: Abstract The engineering design process often entails optimizing the underlying geometry while simultaneously selecting a suitable material. For a certain class of simple problems, the two are separable where, for example, one can first select an optimal material, and then optimize the geometry. However, in general, the two are not separable.

arxiv-2502-18677.title: A new asymptotic regime for the KdV equation with Wigner-von Neumann type initial data Thanks: The author is supported in part by the NSF under grant DMS-2307774.
arxiv-2502-18677.creator: Alexei Rybkin
arxiv-2502-18677.description: Abstract . We investigate the long-time asymptotic behavior of solutions to the Cauchy problem for the KdV equation, focusing on the evolution of the radiant wave associated with a Wigner-von Neumann (WvN) resonance induced by the initial data (potential). A WvN resonance refers to an energy level where the potential exhibits zero transmission (complete reflection).

arxiv-2508-08003.title: Counting Salem numbers arising from arithmetic hyperbolic orbifolds
arxiv-2508-08003.creator: Michelle Chu, Plinio G. P. Murillo, Otto Romero, Lola Thompson
arxiv-2508-08003.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Michelle Chu, Plinio G. P. Murillo, Otto Romero, Lola Thompson. The relationship between Salem numbers and short geodesics has been fruitful in quantitative studies of arithmetic hyperbolic orbifolds, particularly in dimensions 2 and 3. In this article, we push these connections even further.

arxiv-2511-09381.title: Self-Correcting Large Language Models: Generation vs. Multiple Choice
arxiv-2511-09381.creator: Hossein A. Rahmani, Satyapriya Krishna, Xi Wang, Mohammadmehdi Naghiaei, Emine Yilmaz
arxiv-2511-09381.description: Abstract Large language models have recently demonstrated remarkable abilities to self-correct their responses through iterative refinement, often referred to as self-consistency or self-reflection. However, the dynamics of this self-correction mechanism may differ substantially depending on whether the model is tasked with open-ended text generation or with selecting the most appropriate response from multiple predefined options.

pmc-13197561.title: EquityRx Tank: A Shark Tank-Inspired, Game-Based Workshop to Build Persuasive Communication and Collaboration Skills in Health Professions Education
pmc-13197561.creator: Kristina Kaljo, Abbey Kruper
pmc-13197561.description: Health professions education often prioritizes content mastery over essential competencies such as communication, advocacy, and interprofessional collaboration. EquityRx Tank, a Shark Tank-inspired, game-based workshop, was developed to foster persuasive communication and collaboration skills. Grounded in Understanding by Design and Experiential Learning Theory, EquityRx Tank was implemented as a standalone 90-minute session within a six-week summer enrichment program.

In this work, zinc-doped biomimetic calcium phosphate (CaP-Zn) coatings were fabricated on Ti6Al4V through surface activation followed by deposition in supersaturated simulated body fluid (SBF).

pmc-13237218.title: Development and characterization of gelatin–platelet-rich plasma hydrogels for enhanced spinal cord injury repair
pmc-13237218.creator: Shima Ghiasi Moradi, Hesam-Uddin Hoseinzadeh, Hamed Rad
pmc-13237218.description: Spinal cord injury (SCI) remains a major clinical challenge due to the limited regenerative capacity of the central nervous system. This study presents the development and characterization of a gelatin–platelet-rich plasma (PRP) hydrogel as a therapeutic strategy for SCI repair. A composite gelatin–PRP scaffold was fabricated by incorporating PRP into a gelatin matrix to enhance tissue regeneration and functional recovery.

pmc-13441213.title: Gestrinone, lipedema, and the limits of theoretical extrapolation in clinical practice: a critical narrative review
pmc-13441213.creator: Marcelo Fernandes Lima, Marcelo Fernandes Lima
pmc-13441213.description: Lipedema is a chronic inflammatory disorder of adipose tissue that predominantly affects women and is characterized by disproportionate subcutaneous fat accumulation, pain, spontaneous bruising, and significantly impaired quality of life. Although hormonal influences on its pathophysiology have been increasingly recognized, evidence-based treatment options remain limited. Recently, gestrinone has been proposed as an off-label therapy based on hormonal mechanistic hypotheses.

uslaw-usc-t36-s21904.title: 36 U.S.C. § 21904 — Exclusive right to name
uslaw-usc-t36-s21904.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t36-s21904.description: United States Code, Title 36 (Patriotic And National Observances, Ceremonies, And Organizations); Part B (Organizations); Chapter 219 (The American National Theater And Academy). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The corporation and its State and local branches and subdivisions have the exclusive right to use the name “The American National Theater and Academy”.
